posts.author: Pandai
posts.title: Gaming Mircophone Suggestions?
posts.html: Hey guys/gals, I have went through 3 crap headsets this year already, I am not made of money so I am looking for the best and cheap headset under 50$. Any suggestions for people out their that know some microphones that work? Plus, stickmics are out of the question, were living in 2009, not 1997.

posts.author: Fallen
posts.title: Re: Gaming Mircophone Suggestions?
posts.html:
I have used a creative fatality for the past year. most people dismiss anything to do with creative but
this has worked pretty well.
its not bad on the ears and there is no lack in the leather and suede padding.
you can actually just take off the microphone , but i have had no use for this yet.
sniper got one too and broke his (but he always breaks mics). mine is pretty much in the
same condition it came in. you should get it pretty cheap now too.
not only that you get a smexi leather bag to carry it to LAN parties in.



Although if you get a sudden urge to get a more expensive mic, then senheiser or razer microphones
are the top of the range types.
